location . soldiers along the coast of location pitched in to build a wall of sand to try to protect flooding of coastal villages from an oncoming hurricane . they worked to fill heavy bags with sand , closing the bag tightly , and proceeding to the next as quickly as they could .

a helicopter was used to transport the sand bags to the location . it was felt this would be quicker than waiting to load a vehicle . the hurricane was approaching quickly . the soldiers secured the sandbag to the hook and cable so the helicopter could lift it and fly to its destination , just a few miles away .
as the cable raised , so did the sandbag , and it was on its way to join in making a sandbag wall .
the sand was so heavy that the bag did n't swing at all , making the flight easier for the pilot . it took about five minutes for the bag to reach its destination .

as the helicopter flew in , other soldiers unhooked the sandbag and placed it against others , almost like a jigsaw puzzle . dark clouds were rolling in , but the soldiers kept working until they were forced to find cover . their plan worked , and the coastal village was saved from flooding . the inhabitants were grateful to the soldiers for their help , and said they would use that system when a storm or hurricane was predicted in the future .
